title: Preparing Automatic Weather Station, SmartAgri UGM Team Surveys Rice Field Land in Sewon, Bantul

body:
**Bantul, November 6, 2026.** The Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) team from Universitas Gadjah Mada conducted a survey of rice field land in Sewon, Bantul Regency, on Friday (6/11), to examine the location for installing an automatic weather station (_Automatic Weather Station_ or AWS). This activity is part of the preparation for the master's research of Cahyo Putro Dwi Nugroho and was also attended by Ardan Desta Vaunendra.

In the survey, the team examined the land conditions and assessed its suitability as a location for installing the equipment. From the initial inspection, the team determined that the location was suitable and found no obstacles to installation. The team also coordinated with the land owner and obtained permission to install the equipment. "He is very supportive of this research," said Cahyo.

![IMAGE_0]

The AWS equipment has been collected from the Faculty of Agricultural Technology (FTP) UGM and brought to the research location. After the location was inspected and permission was obtained, installation of the equipment is planned in the near future. The weather station will be used to record weather conditions around the field as supporting data for Cahyo's research.

![IMAGE_1]

![IMAGE_2]

Installation of the AWS is the next step before weather observation can begin. Direct recording around the rice field will provide data on local weather conditions throughout the research period.

## Connection to SDGs

-   **SDG 2 – Zero Hunger**, through the preparation of local weather observation to support agricultural research in rice field land.
-   **SDG 9 – Industry, Innovation, and Infrastructure**, through the preparation of an automatic weather station as a means of data collection for field research.

original.body:
**Bantul, 6 November 2026.** Tim Smart Agriculture Research Center (SmartAgri) Universitas Gadjah Mada melakukan survei lahan sawah di Sewon, Kabupaten Bantul, Jumat (6/11), untuk meninjau lokasi pemasangan stasiun cuaca otomatis (_Automatic Weather Station_ atau AWS). Kegiatan ini merupakan bagian dari persiapan penelitian magister Cahyo Putro Dwi Nugroho dan turut diikuti oleh Ardan Desta Vaunendra.

Dalam survei tersebut, tim meninjau kondisi lahan dan menilai kesesuaiannya sebagai lokasi pemasangan perangkat. Dari peninjauan awal, tim menilai lokasi tersebut sesuai dan tidak menemukan hambatan untuk pemasangan. Tim juga berkoordinasi dengan pemilik lahan dan memperoleh izin untuk memasang perangkat. “Beliau sangat mendukung penelitian ini,” ujar Cahyo.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1108-1-whatsapp-image-2026-11-06-at-16.58.32-edited.webp)

Perangkat AWS telah dihimpun dari Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian (FTP) UGM dan dibawa ke lokasi penelitian. Setelah lokasi ditinjau dan izin diperoleh, pemasangan perangkat direncanakan dalam waktu dekat. Stasiun cuaca tersebut akan digunakan untuk mencatat kondisi cuaca di sekitar lahan sebagai data pendukung penelitian Cahyo.

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1108-2-whatsapp-image-2026-11-06-at-16.58.57-edited.webp)

![](/brand/uploads/notes/1108-3-whatsapp-image-2026-11-06-at-16.58.41-edited.webp)

Pemasangan AWS menjadi langkah berikutnya sebelum pengamatan cuaca dapat dimulai. Pencatatan langsung di sekitar sawah akan memberikan data kondisi cuaca setempat selama penelitian berlangsung.

## Keterkaitan dengan SDGs

-   **SDG 2 – Tanpa Kelaparan**, melalui penyiapan pengamatan cuaca setempat untuk mendukung penelitian pertanian di lahan sawah.
-   **SDG 9 – Industri, Inovasi, dan Infrastruktur**, melalui penyiapan stasiun cuaca otomatis sebagai sarana pengumpulan data untuk penelitian lapangan.
